hash_algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON sorted by object keys, ensure_ascii=false, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=false; text hashes use exact UTF-8 text.
blocks: Every nonblank physical line becomes B0001 etc.; offsets count Python Unicode characters, end exclusive; line terminators excluded.

blocks.nonfactual_reason: nonempty iff claim_ids empty; otherwise empty string

claims.quote: nonempty exact substring of own block
claims.context_block_ids: known block IDs including own block and relevant headings/table headers/nearby context
claims.report_scope: nonempty for factual claims: contextual original claim scope
claims.source_scope: nonempty for factual claims: evidenced scope or explicit unknown with reason

ledger_rules: All seven checks are mandatory. Supported requires at least one applicable check, all applicable checks supported, and primary full_section evidence for each; citation alone allows secondary full_section evidence.
Use unknown when scope is unknown; supported must not conceal scope uncertainty. Arithmetic may cite primary input data and explain the calculation in evidence.summary.
nonfactual requires all checks not_applicable. problem requires at least one contradicted or missing_material check.
Block claim membership is reciprocal and complete. Quote matches are exact. Complete block coverage is not proof of atomic completeness.
candidate: Existing replication repair schema, plus mandatory nonempty patch.claim_ids exactly covering every overlapping ledger claim; optional patch.depends_on_patch_ids referencing existing patches with no cycles. Original sources remain unchanged.
guard_packet: schema_version,input_sha256:{original,candidate,ledger},original,candidate_repair,candidate_applied,ledger,block_packet,limitation; CLI also includes input_file_sha256 for exact raw files. No baseline/gold inputs.

guard.evidence: array; may be empty and reference ledger evidence; overlapping IDs must be identical

patch_reviews.coverage_complete: boolean; attest all original assertions, including units omitted from ledger

additions.after_quote: nonempty exact substring of patch.after; enumerate every added factual/citation unit beyond the mapped corrections
additions.claim_ids: known ledger IDs for context; material_omission requires at least one eligible touched claim per factual/citation addition; other known context IDs do not veto

units.claim_ids: array of patch claim IDs; collectively map all; may be empty for an additional original unit
units.before_quote: nonempty exact substring of patch.before, overlapping each referenced claim
units.after_quote: exact substring of patch.after or empty

final_review.selection_binding: Copy every field of preview.selection exactly; operator may attach these after a blinded semantic review.

patch_localization.all_failure_causes_localized: boolean; true only if ALL failure causes are definitely attributable to the listed patches
patch_localization.reason: nonempty explanation; none requires empty IDs and false attestation; pass requires none

guard.final_reviews: Alternative to final_review: ordered array of one or two strict reviews; round 1 is permitted only after a recoverable round-0 failure. Never provide both fields.

gate_rules: Only necessary patches with complete coverage, all mapped claims and accessible full_section necessity evidence survive. Eligibility requires a source-backed correction/removal or the material_omission route; all v3 safety checks still apply.

material_omission uses the same original/candidate/ledger/guard records without relabeling. Every original unit must be literally preserved. SequenceMatcher(autojunk=False) must classify before-to-after as only equal/insert, and reviewed additions must cover all inserted nonwhitespace characters. This conservative alignment may hold ambiguous repeated text.

For material_omission every addition must cover inserted text; at least one is factual/citation. Each factual/citation addition must reference at least one touched claim linked to an existing missing_material check using matching full_section evidence. Other known claim_ids are context and neither authorize nor veto the addition. Citation additions link citation checks; factual additions link non-citation checks. Original units, additions, coverage, necessity and scopes retain all existing validation.

Matching omission evidence means the same evidence ID, or identical normalized HTTPS document URLs: lowercase scheme/hostname, default port 443, empty path '/', and exact path/query/fragment. Freeform locator and summary text may differ and do not participate in identity. Both records must be full_section; factual links require both primary. This establishes source document identity only, not section identity or semantic entailment; independent guard judgments remain responsible for section relevance and entailment. No fuzzy URL matching.
preserved requires identical before_quote and after_quote; even semantically equivalent paraphrases can be held by this conservative rule.

Corrected factual units require primary full_section evidence and nonempty changed after_quote. Citation units in relink patches may use secondary full_section evidence. Nonfactual units may be preserved but not source-corrected.

additions is mandatory even when empty; coverage_reason must attest that all introduced assertions beyond mapped corrections were reviewed, or that none exist. Uncertain/contradicted additions hold the patch. Supported factual additions require primary full_section evidence; citation additions allow secondary full_section evidence.
Any lost/uncertain disposition holds the patch. Supported or uncertain units/ledger claims cannot be removed. Removal requires a contradicted unprotected unit, evidence and empty after_quote.

Rejected dependencies cascade. Added sources referenced by accepted replacements or source_urls survive even if introduced for a rejected patch; never renumber. Numeric token ambiguity conservatively retains sources.
Reuse v5 eligibility, original information protection and source retention without changing frozen inputs or labels.

Screen assembled selected text, not candidate fragments alone. Each bare decimal source-ID token requires a uniquely occurring numeric-only citation-unit/addition quote (one number per physical line, horizontal whitespace allowed). Token boundaries come from the annotation itself, so a declared citation already joined inside a replacement is screened. Original anchors additionally use original standalone lines and numeric-only citation before_quote declarations. Repeated quotes and broad contextual citation quotes do not establish precise numeric intent; record repeated-quote ambiguity and leave it for full semantic review. Numeric source membership alone never classifies a number. Untouched original number lines without citation intent declarations remain for independent review. Complete bracketed citations may appear inline; malformed bracket syntax remains for independent review.

Track exact equal-character original provenance and edit seams. Existing unchanged original joins are not blamed. Counterfactually revert each potential responsible patch: an adjacent edit is excluded from blame if the same anchor-side join remains. Reject definite responsible patches and transitive dependents; reassemble and rescreen to a fixed point without editing any replacement. Ambiguous mechanical attribution vetoes the whole selection.

Every selection binds exact text/sources, input JSON, packet, guard evaluation, exclusion trail and mechanical diagnostics. Final reviews copy all selection fields exactly; stale or malformed reviews raise before applying.

A complete failed full-report review can authorize one removal round only if localization is definite, every ID is selected, the list is nonempty and all failure causes are attested localized. Unknown, incomplete, absent or ambiguous localization cannot recover. Remove only these patches plus dependent/mechanically implicated patches; never rewrite.

The changed full report requires a second independently produced complete pass with its new exact selection binding. No old pass transfers. Failed/incomplete/unknown second review or missing re-review vetoes all remaining patches. Maximum recovery rounds is one.

If localized removal and closure leave no selected patches, recovery terminates with recovery_status=no_remainder, recovery_eligible=false and the original report. No second review is requested and no recovery pass is claimed; an unexpected second review is rejected.

A blinded reviewer can return only status, coverage_complete, reason, patch_localization; the operator attaches the coded selection's binding fields. The code validates structure and provenance, not reviewer independence or truth.
cli: preview --original PATH --candidate PATH --ledger PATH --guard-packet PATH --guard PATH --output-dir DIR
apply --original PATH --candidate PATH --ledger PATH --guard-packet PATH --guard PATH --output-dir DIR
recover --original PATH --candidate PATH --ledger PATH --guard-packet PATH --guard PATH --final-review PATH --output-dir DIR
limitation: Block coverage and exact unit mappings are structural checks, not proof of exhaustive atomic extraction or factual truth; semantic labels are supplied by reviewers. Citation screening covers declared bare numeric citation lines; it does not prove citation intent or semantic correctness.
report_interface: v5-compatible result fields plus mechanical_diagnostics, exclusion_trail, review_history, mechanical_veto, recovery_eligible; selected_applied is the last reviewed/provisional selection, final_applied is original on full veto. Selection is immutable and remains bound to the reviewed selection even when final veto changes effective_repair.
